summary: MATERIAL CHANGE: Josh Downs O36.5 receiving yards -115 at bet365 is a new price-specific BET. The current Covers multi-book board captured during this run shows bet365 four to six yards below the regulated-book cluster: FanDuel 40.5 -114, DraftKings 41.5 -114, BetMGM 42.5 -111, Fanatics 40.5 -120, BetRivers 42.5 -114, Caesars 41.5 -115, theScore Bet 41.5 -110 and Hard Rock 41.5 -115. FanDuel Research independently states Downs' receiving-yards prop was 40.5 as of Saturday morning. Week 1 role was near every-down (88.7% snaps, 85.3% route share) with a 21.1% first-read share despite only four targets; the Colts are 6.5-point underdogs. Projection disagreement remains material, so PRIME uses the market dislocation plus role/game-script evidence rather than any single projection and caps the play at 36.5. No new Grok pass. Existing Dowdle/Juwan/Schultz decisions are unchanged; Taylor remains WATCH without a newly verified acceptable receiving-yard price.

decisions.reason: The bet is driven by a verified threshold/market dislocation plus expanded role and matchup-coverage fit, not merely by a projection above the line. Downs played 88.7% of Week 1 snaps with an 85.3% route share, 12.9% target share and 21.1% first-read share; RotoWire separately charted 32 routes on 34 Daniel Jones dropbacks. Kansas City's high man/two-high usage is favorable to Downs' historical target-earning profile, while Indianapolis' underdog status supports pass volume. Projections range from roughly 37 to 57 yards, so the edge is intentionally capped at 36.5 and should not be chased to the 40.5+ consensus market.
No new official injury or role information found in this run that invalidates the prior price-specific thesis; do not treat unrelated 12.5 receiving-yards quotes as rushing-attempt truth.

No fresher adverse role/injury information was found. FanDuel Research continues to place the broader threshold at 38.5 from Friday afternoon, preserving the prior 34.5 outlier thesis if the exact bet365 price remains live.

Current Covers multi-book board captured this run still shows FanDuel O41.5 -114 while other regulated books are generally higher. Nico Collins remains officially out. No chase above the stored 41.5 ceiling.

A current Saturday source lists Taylor receiving yards at 17.5 -114, above PRIME's stored 15.5 ceiling. FanDuel's Saturday update only exposes his rushing-yards prop, not a better receiving price. Do not chase.
